source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all eleven Santo Domingo rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: Aldecaldo Peacekeepers HQ
entities.source_summary: Headquarters for the Aldecaldo Peacekeepers, with vehicle garages, dormitories and a short-term jail; no customer-facing paid service is described.

entities.name: Aldecaldo Warriors Track
entities.source_summary: Outdoor roller-derby track and training venue whose facilities are also used by student squads; the source explicitly sells the 10eb Warriors Nacho Thunderbowl.

entities.name: Altar a Nuestra Señora de la Santa Muerte
entities.source_summary: Religious altar hidden inside an abandoned warehouse and visited by worshippers; no commerce is stated.

entities.name: Ciudad Techito
entities.source_summary: Dense improvised housing community whose layout shifts as residents move; local children explicitly offer paid navigation through the settlement.

entities.name: Ciudad Techito Local Guides
entities.source_summary: Source-explicit but unnamed local children offer navigation through Ciudad Techito for small cash payments.

entities.name: Coronado Dam
entities.source_summary: Petrochem-managed dam supplying Night City drinking water and guarded as critical infrastructure; no commercial customer operation is stated.

entities.name: East Cargo Village
entities.source_summary: Cargo-container residential community used by nomads and local workers; the source describes temporary lodging patterns but no explicit rental operator or transaction.

entities.name: Heywood Suites
entities.source_summary: Combined cube hotel and apartment building beneath the New Pacific Highway, with extensive noise- and vibration-damping measures.

entities.name: Hunger Street
entities.source_summary: Daytime street-food cluster outside Megabuilding H4, packed with named food trucks offering inexpensive prepared meals.

entities.name: Buck-a-Slice
entities.source_summary: Named Hunger Street food truck specializing in inexpensive greasy pizza.

entities.name: Cart Chrome
entities.source_summary: Named Hunger Street food truck selling glucose-rich brain solution aimed at FBC construction workers.

entities.name: Monster T
entities.source_summary: Named Hunger Street food truck serving highly caffeinated tea with small SCOP balls.

entities.name: SharkBites
entities.source_summary: Named Hunger Street food truck selling buckets of springy meat nuggets advertised as real shark.

entities.name: TacoSCOP
entities.source_summary: Named Hunger Street food truck serving SCOP tacos flavored to resemble old-fashioned fast-food tacos.

entities.name: NCPD Precinct #2
entities.source_summary: Fortified NCPD station with armories, drone operations and repair bays; these are internal police facilities rather than customer-facing commerce.

entities.name: Salón de Valentino
entities.source_summary: Santo Domingo's municipal government building, with explicitly public-facing offices on the first floor and City Manager offices and apartments above.

services.label: Public municipal administration and City Manager services

entities.name: SovOil Paint Factory
entities.source_summary: SovOil latex-paint factory operating continuously as industrial production infrastructure; no public factory shop or direct sales point is stated.
